title: THE LAST CLICK
narration: A judge does not see your local build. They see a link. If that link fails, strong work disappears before it can be judged.
captions: A judge does not see your local build. They see a link.
If that link fails, strong work disappears before it can be judged.

title: THE JUDGE VIEW
narration: Submitline gives a hackathon entry one last outside-in check. The draft and judge view sit side by side, tied to LovHack’s published requirements.
captions: Submitline gives a hackathon entry one last outside-in check.
The draft and judge view sit side by side, tied to LovHack’s published requirements.

title: A REAL CONTRACT
narration: Each requirement keeps its source nearby. A live demo matters when possible; a repository is optional; a two-to-three-minute video is required.
captions: Each requirement keeps its source nearby.
A live demo matters when possible; a repository is optional; a two-to-three-minute video is required.

title: A DELIBERATE FAILURE
narration: For this walkthrough, I load Northstar, a clearly marked fictional example. Its live address is intentionally broken. These are test inputs, not a real hackathon entry.
captions: For this walkthrough, I load Northstar, a clearly marked fictional example.
Its live address is intentionally broken. These are test inputs, not a real hackathon entry.

title: THE WHOLE ENTRY
narration: The example includes its story, technologies, build-period work, reuse disclosure, repository, and video link. Submitline does not flatten those different obligations into one score.
captions: The example includes its story, technologies, build-period work, reuse disclosure, repository, and video link.
Submitline does not flatten those different obligations into one score.

title: PREFLIGHT
narration: Now I run the preflight. The server checks these URLs without a sign-in. The live address returns HTTP four-oh-four: a blocker a judge would hit too.
captions: Now I run the preflight. The server checks these URLs without a sign-in.
The live address returns HTTP four-oh-four: a blocker a judge would hit too.

title: NO FALSE PASS
narration: The public repository can be confirmed. The video link exposes metadata. But metadata is not playback or proof of what the demo shows, so that remains human review.
captions: The public repository can be confirmed. The video link exposes metadata.
But metadata is not playback or proof of what the demo shows, so that remains human review.

title: FIX ONLY WHAT FAILED
narration: I replace the dead address and recheck only that item. The fresh request reaches example dot com. Reachability is evidence, not proof of functionality.
captions: I replace the dead address and recheck only that item.
The fresh request reaches example dot com. Reachability is evidence, not proof of functionality.

title: EVIDENCE, NOT A SCORE
narration: Each status states what was observed and points back to its rule. Entrants still confirm their claims and watch the public video while logged out.
captions: Each status states what was observed and points back to its rule.
Entrants still confirm their claims and watch the public video while logged out.

title: VIDEO, HONESTLY
narration: With consent and a deAPI key, Video Description can return timestamped observations of visible scenes. No key is configured for this recording, so no model result is shown.
captions: With consent and a deAPI key, Video Description can return timestamped observations of visible scenes.
No key is configured for this recording, so no model result is shown.

title: READY TO SUBMIT
narration: Finally, I export the checklist: rules, observed links, and the manual checks that remain. Submitline. Built by Rishik Rontala. One last look before they click.
captions: Finally, I export the checklist: rules, observed links, and the manual checks that remain.
